articles.title: Over 650 participants compete in Chinar Open Winter Games 2026 at Gulmarg
articles.summary: The two-day Chinar Open Winter Games 2026 concluded at Gulmarg, Jammu and Kashmir, witnessing over 650 participants in eight events. This significant event, likely organized or supported by the Indian Army's Chinar Corps, promotes sportsmanship and community engagement, showcasing the region's talent and fostering a positive environment through winter sports.

articles.title: Operation Jwala: Arms, ammo recovered near LoC in J&K’s Rajouri
articles.summary: Under 'Operation Jwala,' Indian security forces successfully recovered significant arms and ammunition near the Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu and Kashmir's Rajouri district. This operation highlights ongoing efforts to neutralize threats and maintain vigilance against infiltrators and terror elements along the sensitive border region, ensuring national security and stability for the nation.

articles.title: Ooredoo separates fibre and subsea assets to power regional growth
articles.summary: Amidst rising global bandwidth demand and AI-driven cloud expansion, Ooredoo is establishing an independent business focused on international services. This strategic move aims to adapt to the evolving digital landscape, capitalizing on new traffic corridors and infrastructure needs worldwide. It highlights how telecommunication companies are restructuring to meet the demands of AI and increasing data flow.

articles.title: Weapon cache, supplies recovered along LoC day after troops foiled infiltration bid in Rajouri
articles.summary: Security forces in Jammu and Kashmir's Rajouri district recovered a significant cache of arms and ammunition during a search operation on Friday. This crucial recovery followed a successful operation a day prior, where Indian troops effectively foiled an infiltration bid in the same area. Such actions highlight the Indian Army's vigilance and operational readiness in maintaining border security and combating insurgency in the region.

articles.title: Pak violates ceasefire along LoC in Kupwara
articles.summary: Pakistan violated the ceasefire along the Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kupwara district on Friday. Officials reported the incident occurred around noon, underscoring persistent border tensions. These violations are crucial for SSB aspirants to understand, as they highlight ongoing national security challenges and the constant vigilance required by Indian defence forces.

articles.title: The Golden Schmoes: The Nominees Are Live – Vote for the winners today!
articles.summary: The Golden Schmoes, reputedly the longest-running online movie fan awards, provide an alternative platform for enthusiasts to express their views on annual film nominations, in contrast to established awards like the Oscars. These awards celebrate fan engagement, highlighting the growing influence of audience sentiment and online participation in shaping perceptions within the global entertainment industry.
